title: 7,000 實用英語單字清單（CEFR A1–B1）
section: 第 1,401–1,450 個單字（CEFR A2 初級）

examples.en: We visited a contemporary art exhibition at Songshan Cultural Park.
examples.zh: 我們參觀了松山文創園區的當代藝術特展。

examples.en: The museum's dinosaur fossil exhibition attracted thousands of children.
examples.zh: 該博物館的恐龍化石展覽吸引了成千上萬的孩童。

examples.en: Several international technology brands displayed their innovations at the trade exhibition.
examples.zh: 數家國際科技品牌在貿易展覽會上展示了他們的創新成果。

examples.en: The Chimei Museum in Tainan exhibits Western art and antique instruments.
examples.zh: 台南奇美博物館展出西方藝術品與古董樂器。

examples.en: Admission to the science museum is free on the first Monday of each month.
examples.zh: 每個月的第一個星期一參觀科學博物館免費入場。

examples.en: A knowledgeable museum guide walked us through the Egyptian ancient relics gallery.
examples.zh: 一位見多識廣的博物館導覽員帶領我們參觀埃及古文物展廳。

examples.en: The National Palace Museum houses thousands of priceless historic treasures.
examples.zh: 國立故宮博物院收藏了數千件無價歷史國寶。

examples.en: Tourists marvel at the exquisite details of the Jadeite Cabbage at the National Palace Museum.
examples.zh: 遊客們在國立故宮博物院驚嘆於翠玉白菜的精緻細節。

examples.en: The Southern Branch of the National Palace Museum in Chiayi features Asian textiles and ceramics.
examples.zh: 位於嘉義的國立故宮博物院南部院區以亞洲織品與陶瓷器為特色展覽。

examples.en: Local artists display their paintings in this downtown art gallery.
examples.zh: 在地藝術家在這家市中心畫廊展出其畫作。

examples.en: She walked quietly through the photo gallery admiring the black-and-white portraits.
examples.zh: 她安靜地漫步穿過攝影藝廊，欣賞著黑白肖像照片。

examples.en: You can swipe left on your phone screen to view images in the picture gallery.
examples.zh: 您可以在手機螢幕上向左滑動以瀏覽圖片圖庫中的照片。

examples.en: The Mona Lisa is Leonardo da Vinci's most celebrated masterpiece.
examples.zh: 《蒙娜麗莎》是達文西最負盛名的傳世傑作。

examples.en: The director's latest historical drama was praised as a cinematic masterpiece.
examples.zh: 這位導演的最新歷史長片被譽為影壇的經典傑作。

examples.en: Beethoven composed his ninth symphony masterpiece even after losing his hearing.
examples.zh: 貝多芬即使在喪失聽力之後，仍舊譜寫出了他的第九號交響曲傳世傑作。

examples.en: The stone sculpture in front of the plaza represents peace.
examples.zh: 廣場前方的石雕作品象徵著和平。

examples.en: Michelangelo carved majestic sculptures out of massive blocks of Italian marble.
examples.zh: 米開朗基羅將大塊義大利大理石雕刻成一座座雄偉的雕塑。

examples.en: An abstract bronze sculpture was unveiled in the botanical garden.
examples.zh: 一座抽象青銅雕塑在植物園中正式揭幕亮相。

examples.en: The painter painted a realistic oil portrait of the grandmother.
examples.zh: 畫家為祖母畫了一幅栩栩如生的油畫肖像。

examples.en: Hang the family portrait above the living room fireplace.
examples.zh: 把全家福肖像照片掛在客廳壁爐上方。

examples.en: The smartphone camera automatically switches to portrait mode to blur backgrounds.
examples.zh: 智慧型手機相機會自動切換至人像肖像模式以虛化背景。

examples.en: Taiwan's East Coast features dramatic mountainous landscapes.
examples.zh: 台灣東海岸擁有令人驚嘆的壯麗山海景觀。

examples.en: Claude Monet created magnificent landscape paintings of water lilies.
examples.zh: 克勞德·莫內創作了多幅壯麗絕倫的睡蓮風景名畫。

examples.en: Rapid technological progress has transformed the modern business landscape.
examples.zh: 飛速的科技進步徹底改變了現代商業環境的整體生態格局。

examples.en: Let's go to the cinema to watch the newly released superhero film.
examples.zh: 我們去電影院看新上映的超級英雄電影吧。

examples.en: The historic movie cinema was renovated with plush leather seats and surround sound.
examples.zh: 這家歷史悠久的電影院改裝了豪華真皮座椅與環繞音響設備。

examples.en: French cinema has had a profound influence on global filmmaking history.
examples.zh: 法國電影藝術對全球電影製作歷史產生了深遠的影響。

examples.en: General admission to the museum is free on national holidays.
examples.zh: 國定假日期間進入該博物館一律免費入場。

examples.en: High school graduates celebrate when receiving university admission letters.
examples.zh: 高中畢業生在收到大學錄取入學通知書時歡呼慶祝。

examples.en: His prompt admission of the mistake earned the respect of his colleagues.
examples.zh: 他迅速坦承錯誤的誠懇態度贏得了同事們的敬重。

examples.en: The new animated movie was a huge box office success.
examples.zh: 這部新動畫電影在票房上取得了巨大的成功。

examples.en: You can buy remaining seats at the theatre box office before curtain call.
examples.zh: 您可以在演出開演前在劇院售票處購買剩餘座位。

examples.en: The summer blockbuster broke historical box office records across the country.
examples.zh: 這部暑期強檔大片打破了全美各地的歷史票房紀錄。

examples.en: Cloud Gate Dance Theatre delivered a mesmerizing modern dance performance.
examples.zh: 雲門舞集帶來了一場令人著迷的現代舞演出。

examples.en: Regular system maintenance ensures optimal performance of your computer hardware.
examples.zh: 定期系統維護能確保你的電腦硬體維持最佳運作效能。

examples.en: Employees receive annual bonuses based on their job performance evaluations.
examples.zh: 員工根據其工作績效評估獲得年度年終獎金。

examples.en: The student band will perform live at the campus music festival.
examples.zh: 學生樂團將在校園音樂祭上進行現場演出。

examples.en: The neurosurgeon performed the delicate brain procedure with steady hands.
examples.zh: 神經外科醫師以沉穩的雙手執行了這項精細的腦部手術。

examples.en: Electric vehicles perform exceptionally well in city stop-and-go driving.
examples.zh: 電動車在市區頻繁起步煞車的行駛條件下表現格外優異。

examples.en: Talented street performers entertain crowds along the Tamsui boardwalk.
examples.zh: 才華橫溢的街頭藝人在淡水老街木棧道旁娛樂民眾。

examples.en: Circus performers showcased astonishing acrobatics high above the arena.
examples.zh: 馬戲團表演者在競技場高空展示了令人驚嘆的特技雜技。

examples.en: She was nominated as the most outstanding musical theater performer of the year.
examples.zh: 她被提名為本年度最傑出的音樂劇表演藝術家。

examples.en: The singer walked onto the brightly lit stage amidst cheers.
examples.zh: 歌手在全場歡呼聲中步上燈火通明的舞台。

examples.en: The clinical drug trials are currently in their final development stage.
examples.zh: 該臨床藥物試驗目前正處於最後的研發測試階段。

examples.en: Local activists staged a peaceful protest outside the legislative building.
examples.zh: 當地社運人士在立法院大樓外發起了一場和平抗議。

examples.en: The entire audience stood up and gave a standing ovation.
examples.zh: 全體觀眾紛紛起立報以熱烈掌聲。

examples.en: The podcast host tailors his content specifically for a young tech-savvy audience.
examples.zh: 這位播客節目主持人專為懂科技的年輕受眾群體量身打造內容。

examples.en: The foreign ambassador was granted a private audience with the president.
examples.zh: 這位外國特使獲得了與總統單獨親切會面接見的機會。

examples.en: The violin solo ended with thunderous applause from the crowd.
examples.zh: 小提琴獨奏在全場如雷的掌聲中圓滿落幕。

examples.en: A warm round of applause greeted the guest speaker as she approached the podium.
examples.zh: 當客座主講人走向講台時，台下響起了熱烈的歡迎掌聲。

examples.en: The young pianist bowed gracefully in response to the audience's enthusiastic applause.
examples.zh: 年輕的鋼琴家優雅地鞠躬致意，回應觀眾們熱情的熱烈鼓掌。

examples.en: Everyone applauded enthusiastically after the keynote speech.
examples.zh: 專題演講結束後，每個人都熱情地鼓掌致意。

examples.en: We should applaud the government's courageous decision to protect national forests.
examples.zh: 我們應當為政府保護國有林地的勇敢決策鼓掌喝采。

examples.en: The audience stood and applauded as the actors took their final bows.
examples.zh: 當演員們謝幕鞠躬時，台下觀眾全體起立拍手喝采。

examples.en: Mayday held a massive outdoor stadium concert in Kaohsiung.
examples.zh: 五月天在高雄舉辦了一場大型戶外體育場演唱會。

examples.en: We bought front-row tickets to hear the world-famous cellist in concert.
examples.zh: 我們買了前排門票以親臨音樂會聆聽這位世界級大提琴家的演奏。

examples.en: The world powers took concerted diplomatic action to prevent war.
examples.zh: 各世界強權採取了一致協調的聯合外交行動以預防戰爭爆發。

examples.en: The cozy cafe invites a live jazz band every Saturday night.
examples.zh: 這家溫馨咖啡廳每週六晚上都會邀請現場爵士樂團演奏。

examples.en: Nothing beats the electric energy of dancing to a live rock band.
examples.zh: 沒有任何體驗比隨著現場搖滾樂團的演奏盡情起舞更令人熱血沸騰。

examples.en: The wedding reception featured a four-piece live band playing romantic covers.
examples.zh: 婚宴現場安排了一支四人現場伴奏樂團翻唱浪漫情歌。

examples.en: The National Symphony Orchestra performed Beethoven's Fifth Symphony.
examples.zh: 國家交響樂團演奏了貝多芬第五號交響曲。

examples.en: The conductor raised his hands, and the full orchestra burst into melody.
examples.zh: 指揮雙手揚起，整座交響樂團隨即迸發出壯麗悠揚的旋律。

examples.en: We sat in the front balcony overlooking the seated musicians in the orchestra pit.
examples.zh: 我們坐在二樓前排包廂，俯瞰著坐在樂池內的樂團樂手們。

examples.en: Jay Chou is one of Asia's most influential pop musicians.
examples.zh: 周杰倫是亞洲最具影響力的流行音樂家之一。

examples.en: Street musicians fill the pedestrian plazas with lively guitar music.
examples.zh: 街頭音樂家以熱情活潑的吉他音樂充滿了行人徒步廣場。

examples.en: Being a successful professional musician demands immense discipline and creative passion.
examples.zh: 成為一名成功的職業音樂家需要極大的自律與源源不絕的創作熱情。

examples.en: The poetic song lyrics touched the hearts of many listeners.
examples.zh: 這首歌曲富含詩意的歌詞觸動了無數聽眾的心弦。

examples.en: She knows all the English lyrics to her favorite pop albums by heart.
examples.zh: 她能把最喜愛的流行音樂專輯中所有的英文歌詞倒背如流。

examples.en: The songwriter spent weeks polishing the chorus lyrics until they rhymed naturally.
examples.zh: 這位詞曲創作者花了數週潤飾副歌歌詞，直到文字自然押韻為止。

examples.en: The gentle piano melody helped the restless baby fall asleep.
examples.zh: 輕柔的鋼琴旋律幫助躁動的嬰兒安然入睡。

examples.en: That catchy television commercial melody has been stuck in my head all morning.
examples.zh: 那支電視廣告洗腦好記的旋律在我腦海中迴盪了一整個早晨。

examples.en: The flutist played an ancient folklore melody that sounded melancholic and pure.
examples.zh: 長笛演奏家吹奏了一首聽起來既憂傷又純淨的古老民謠旋律。

examples.en: Clap your hands along with the lively rhythm of the music.
examples.zh: 跟隨音樂歡快的節奏一起拍拍手。

examples.en: Maintaining a steady daily sleep rhythm improves your mental focus.
examples.zh: 維持規律穩定的每日作息生理節奏有助於提升專注力。

examples.en: Latin dances are characterized by fast, energetic hip rhythms.
examples.zh: 拉丁舞的特色在於快速且充滿活力的臀部節奏律動。

examples.en: Learning to play the guitar is a popular hobby among teenagers.
examples.zh: 學習彈吉他是青少年間非常熱門的興趣嗜好。

examples.en: He replaced the nylon strings on his classical guitar before the audition.
examples.zh: 他在面試試音前更換了古典吉他上的尼龍琴弦。

examples.en: She sat on the grass strumming popular pop chords on her guitar.
examples.zh: 她坐在草地上，用吉他輕輕彈奏著耳熟能詳的流行和弦。

examples.en: He strummed his acoustic guitar gently by the campfire.
examples.zh: 他在營火旁輕輕撥彈著他的木吉他。

examples.en: The warm, woody resonance of an acoustic guitar is perfect for indie folk music.
examples.zh: 木吉他溫暖醇厚的木質共鳴非常適合獨立民謠音樂。

examples.en: She bought a solid-wood acoustic guitar with money saved from her summer job.
examples.zh: 她用暑假打工存下來的積蓄買了一把全單板原聲木吉他。

examples.en: The rock guitarist played an explosive solo on his electric guitar.
examples.zh: 搖滾吉他手用電吉他飆出了一段極具爆發力的獨奏。

examples.en: Plug your electric guitar into the amplifier using a heavy-duty cable.
examples.zh: 使用耐用音訊線將你的電吉他插上音箱擴大機。

examples.en: Heavy metal bands rely on distorted electric guitars for powerful riffs.
examples.zh: 重金屬樂團依賴破音效果的電吉他來演奏震撼有力的吉他樂句。

examples.en: She has practiced playing classical piano since age five.
examples.zh: 她從五歲起就開始練習彈奏古典鋼琴。

examples.en: The technician was hired to tune the concert grand piano before the recital.
examples.zh: 調音技師受聘在獨奏會開始前為演奏級平台大鋼琴進行調音。

examples.en: Learning to play the piano develops strong rhythmic awareness and finger strength.
examples.zh: 學習彈鋼琴能培養強烈的節奏敏銳感與手指獨立指力。

examples.en: The violin soloist played with incredible passion and precision.
examples.zh: 小提琴獨奏家以無比的熱情與精準度進行演奏。

examples.en: An authentic Stradivarius violin can sell for millions of dollars at auction.
examples.zh: 真正的史特拉第瓦里古董名琴在拍賣會上能拍出數百萬美元天價。

examples.en: Rosin your violin bow thoroughly before practicing classical etudes.
examples.zh: 在練習古典練習曲前，請用松香仔細擦拭你的小提琴琴弓。

examples.en: The energetic drummer kept the beat tight throughout the song.
examples.zh: 活力十足的鼓手在整首歌曲中維持著精準穩定的節拍。

examples.en: Heavy thunder rattled the windows like a giant war drum in the sky.
examples.zh: 沉悶的雷聲如天空中的巨大戰鼓般震動著窗戶玻璃。

examples.en: Soldiers marched in sync to the rhythmic cadence of the snare drums.
examples.zh: 士兵們在小軍鼓富有節奏的鼓點節奏下一步調一致地行軍。

examples.en: The Golden Horse Film Festival celebrates exceptional Mandarin cinema.
examples.zh: 金馬影展表揚傑出的華語電影作品。

examples.en: Vintage photography enthusiasts love shooting street scenes on 35mm film.
examples.zh: 復古底片攝影愛好者熱愛用 35mm 膠卷拍攝街頭風光。

examples.en: A thin oily film floated on the surface of the harbor water.
examples.zh: 一層薄薄的油漬薄膜漂浮在港灣水面上。

examples.en: What is your favorite movie genre — comedy, action, or sci-fi?
examples.zh: 你最喜愛的電影類型是什麼 — 喜劇、動作片還是科幻片？

examples.en: Jazz and hip-hop are distinct musical genres with deep cultural histories.
examples.zh: 爵士樂與嘻哈是兩種具有深厚文化歷史脈絡的獨特音樂流派。

examples.en: His debut mystery novel blurred the lines between different literary genres.
examples.zh: 他的處女作推理小說模糊了不同文學體裁之間的界線。

examples.en: Watching a lighthearted romantic comedy always cheers me up.
examples.zh: 看一部輕鬆浪漫的喜劇片總是能讓我心情大好。

examples.en: The stand-up comedy club was packed with people laughing hysterically.
examples.zh: 單口喜劇脫口秀俱樂部裡擠滿了捧腹大笑的觀眾。

examples.en: The theatrical production balanced slapstick comedy with poignant drama.
examples.zh: 這部舞台劇製作巧妙平衡了肢體鬧劇幽默與動人深刻的情感。

examples.en: Shakespeare's Romeo and Juliet is a world-famous romantic tragedy.
examples.zh: 莎士比亞的《羅密歐與茱麗葉》是舉世聞名的浪漫愛情悲劇。

examples.en: The sudden train collision was an unbearable national tragedy.
examples.zh: 這起突發的列車相撞意外是一場令人痛心難以承受的國家級慘事悲劇。

examples.en: It would be a tragedy if historic architectural landmarks were demolished.
examples.zh: 若這些歷史建築地標慘遭拆除，那將會是一場莫大的悲劇與憾事。

examples.en: Japanese animation films enjoy widespread popularity in Taiwan.
examples.zh: 日本動畫電影在台灣享有極高的人氣。

examples.en: Computer animation studios use complex 3D software to bring characters to life.
examples.zh: 電腦動畫工作室使用複雜的 3D 軟體賦予虛擬角色鮮活性命。

examples.en: The teacher used animated graphics to explain complicated physics principles to students.
examples.zh: 老師使用動態動畫圖解向學生闡明複雜的物理原理。

examples.en: 'Beyond Beauty: Taiwan from Above' is an inspiring nature documentary.
examples.zh: 《看見台灣》是一部發人深省的自然生態紀錄片。

examples.en: The television crew spent five years filming an investigative documentary on climate change.
examples.zh: 電視攝製團隊花了五年時間拍攝了一部關於氣候變遷的調查紀錄片。

examples.en: Watching historical documentaries provides a rich perspective on modern global affairs.
examples.zh: 收看歷史紀錄片能為理解當代國際事務提供深刻豐厚的視角。

examples.en: The movie tells a touching romance set in 1980s Taipei.
examples.zh: 這部電影講述了發生在 1980 年代台北的感人愛情故事。

examples.en: He still believes in the timeless romance of writing handwritten love letters.
examples.zh: 他依舊堅信親筆書寫紙本情書那份歷久彌新的浪漫情調。

examples.en: Backpacking through the Swiss Alps rekindled their romance and love for adventure.
examples.zh: 背包徒步穿越瑞士阿爾卑斯山重新點燃了他們的浪漫愛火與冒險熱情。

examples.en: I love sci-fi movies about space exploration and time travel.
examples.zh: 我熱愛關於太空探索與時空穿越的科幻電影。

examples.en: Classic sci-fi literature often accurately predicted technologies we use today.
examples.zh: 經典的科幻文學往往精準預言了我們今日所使用的科技發明。

examples.en: The new sci-fi series depicts human civilization colonizing distant star systems.
examples.zh: 這部全新科幻影集描繪了人類文明在遙遠恆星系統建立殖民地的歷程。

examples.en: Fast car chases and martial arts stunts are typical in action movies.
examples.zh: 飛車追逐與武打特技是動作電影的經典元素。

examples.en: He munched on popcorn while watching the thrilling Hollywood action movie.
examples.zh: 他一邊吃著爆米花，一邊津津有味地看著刺激的熱血好萊塢動作片。

examples.en: The director is renowned for orchestrating explosive, high-octane action movies.
examples.zh: 這位導演以執導場面震撼、扣人心弦的爆破動作片而享譽業界。

examples.en: Watching scary horror movies late at night gave me goosebumps.
examples.zh: 深夜看恐怖鬼片讓我渾身起雞皮疙瘩。

examples.en: She covered her eyes with both hands during the scariest jump scenes in the horror movie.
examples.zh: 在恐怖片最嚇人的驚嚇鏡頭時，她用雙手緊緊遮住了眼睛。

examples.en: The abandoned hospital was the spooky setting for the indie horror movie.
examples.zh: 這座荒廢的醫院是這部獨立恐怖電影毛骨悚然的取景拍攝地。

examples.en: Ang Lee is an Oscar-winning Taiwanese film director.
examples.zh: 李安是榮獲奧斯卡金像獎的台灣傑出電影導演。

examples.en: The board of directors held an extraordinary meeting to discuss the corporate merger.
examples.zh: 董事會召開了臨時全體會議以討論企業併購案。

examples.en: She was promoted to creative director of the international advertising firm.
examples.zh: 她被拔擢晉升為這家跨國廣告公司的創意總監。

examples.en: The lead actor gave an emotional and convincing performance.
examples.zh: 男主角帶來了極富感染力且令人信服的精湛演出。

examples.en: He auditioned for several roles before landing his breakthrough part as a dramatic actor.
examples.zh: 在獲得突破性的戲劇要角之前，他參加過許多角色的試鏡。

examples.en: Many renowned theater actors also teach masterclasses at acting academies.
examples.zh: 許多著名的劇場演員也在戲劇學院講授大師班課程。

examples.en: Totoro is a beloved animated character created by Hayao Miyazaki.
examples.zh: 龍貓是宮崎駿所創造的深受喜愛的動畫角色。

examples.en: Overcoming adversity builds resilience and strengthens one's moral character.
examples.zh: 克服逆境能鍛鍊人的心理韌性並磨礪品格。

examples.en: Learning to write traditional Chinese characters requires careful stroke order discipline.
examples.zh: 學習書寫繁體漢字需要嚴謹遵守筆畫順序的自律規範。

examples.en: The movie has an unpredictable plot twist at the very end.
examples.zh: 這部電影在最後結尾處出現了出人意料的情節大反轉。

examples.en: Conspirators formed a secret plot to overthrow the corrupt ruler.
examples.zh: 密謀者秘密策劃了一場推翻腐敗統治者的政變陰謀。

examples.en: They bought a small plot of farmland to grow organic sweet potatoes.
examples.zh: 他們買了一小塊農地來栽種有機甜地瓜。

examples.en: The opening sunset scene by the beach was breathtakingly beautiful.
examples.zh: 海灘邊的日落開場場景美得令人屏息。

examples.en: Police and forensic detectives arrived quickly at the crime scene.
examples.zh: 警方與鑑識小組探員迅速抵達了犯罪現場。

examples.en: Taipei boasts a vibrant underground indie music scene with weekly live shows.
examples.zh: 台北擁有蓬勃發展的地下獨立音樂圈，每週都有現場演出。

examples.en: Turn on English subtitles to improve your listening skills while watching movies.
examples.zh: 看電影時開啟英文字幕以加強英語聽力技巧。

examples.en: The documentary features bilingual subtitles in both English and Mandarin.
examples.zh: 這部紀錄片配有英漢雙語對照字幕。

examples.en: Reading foreign movie subtitles quickly becomes second nature with practice.
examples.zh: 透過練習，快速閱讀外語電影字幕很快就會變成一種直覺習慣。

examples.en: The movie's original soundtrack became a chart-topping hit album.
examples.zh: 該電影的原聲帶專輯榮登各大音樂排行榜冠軍。

examples.en: Ennio Morricone composed legendary instrumental soundtracks for Western cinema classics.
examples.zh: 顏尼歐·莫利克奈為多部經典西部電影譜寫了傳奇配樂原聲帶。

examples.en: I listen to the calming ambient movie soundtrack while studying in the library.
examples.zh: 在圖書館研讀功課時，我會聆聽這部電影平靜舒緩的原聲帶音樂。

examples.en: Landscape photography requires patience to capture the perfect natural light.
examples.zh: 風景攝影需要耐心等待以捕捉最完美的自然光線。

examples.en: She took up street photography as a creative hobby to document city life.
examples.zh: 她將街頭攝影作為記錄城市生活的創意興趣嗜好。

examples.en: Drone aerial photography provides breathtaking bird's-eye views of Taiwan's coastlines.
examples.zh: 空拍無人機空拍攝影為台灣沿海海岸線提供了壯麗的鳥瞰全景。

examples.en: Tourists love taking selfies in front of the colorful Rainbow Village.
examples.zh: 遊客們喜歡在色彩斑斕的彩虹眷村前拍照自拍。

examples.en: Extend the telescopic selfie stick to fit all your friends into the frame.
examples.zh: 伸長伸縮自拍棒，好把所有的朋友通通納入鏡頭畫面中。

examples.en: She snapped a quick selfie with her best friend at the cafe entrance.
examples.zh: 她在咖啡館門口與她最好的摯友拍了一張迅速的合照自拍。
